title: Lk's Attire — a women's fashion store from Tangail, and the template behind the next one
summary: A bilingual shop for a Tangail fashion brand: a checkout that fills a Bangladeshi address from a postcode, prices, discounts and delivery decided on the server, invoice numbers and SKUs, a dashboard the owner changes everything from — and a brand pipeline that turns the same code into the next client's shop.
role: Sole developer — architecture, backend, frontend, brand design, DevOps, testing and documentation
stack: TypeScript · Hono · Cloudflare Workers, D1, KV, R2 · GitHub Actions · Vitest · Playwright
highlights: Checkout fills division, district and upazila from a postcode or place name, in Bangla or English, with the delivery fee by zone
Discounts, coupons and per-product free or fixed delivery resolved on the server; stock the database will not let go negative
Invoice numbers and unique SKUs, and one admin search that finds a customer by invoice, phone, name, TrxID or SKU
Owner-run dashboard: logo, banners, offers, bKash/Nagad numbers, SMS wording, zones and staff roles — all bilingual
CI that creates its own D1, KV and R2 and deploys; a live demo running the real code in the browser
